note: E180 s0 C1: reference-case records the contract refuses, one defect each on a set of sets.json (`base`). `patch` is JSON Patch (add, replace, remove) plus `fill`: the list at `path` becomes `count` copies of its first item. A shape case is refused by the published JSON Schema and by the model; a semantic case passes the JSON Schema and is refused by the model with `error` in its message (strategy §3.1: consistency is the model's, and the generators have no patternProperties or minProperties).
